title: Nice but not a lot of team for the money
text: I like this way to try new teas but what I dislike is that they only give you a small amount of tea. It’s barely enough to get a few cups out of per pack and I would have expected more for the money.  I find that spending about half what this costs I can get a large tin of loose leaf tea and that may be the best way to try them out.
label: negative
